about:
All American Woodworks, LLC operates from Fairlee, Vermont, where it has served the Upper Valley region for over three decades. The company was established more than 30 years ago as a local custom woodworking and cabinet-making shop, though a precise founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, built-in cabinetry, and freestanding furniture for both residential and commercial clients. Work is performed on a project basis, with no published facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Customers range from homeowners seeking bespoke kitchen and bath solutions to businesses requiring custom millwork for commercial spaces. The company does not list specific industry verticals beyond the broad residential and commercial categories.

The firm emphasizes its long-standing presence in the Vermont Upper Valley as a mark of reliability, but does not publish a formal mission statement or explicit differentiators beyond experience and local service.
